mainEntity.name: What is Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) travel insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cancel For Any Reason (CFAR) is an optional upgrade to a base travel insurance plan that lets you cancel your trip for any reason not otherwise covered by the plan and receive partial reimbursement of your prepaid, non-refundable trip costs.

CFAR is added as a percentage upgrade to your base Travel Guard plan. The total cost depends on your base plan, total trip cost, and traveler age. Get a personalized quote at travelguard.com or call 800-826-5248.

mainEntity.name: How much will CFAR reimburse if I cancel?

acceptedAnswer.text: CFAR typically reimburses a percentage of your prepaid, non-refundable trip costs (the exact percentage is shown on your Schedule of Benefits). It is not a 100% refund — review your policy documents for the specific reimbursement percentage.
CFAR must be purchased within a set window (typically 15 days) of your initial trip deposit. After that window, it is no longer available to add to your plan.

mainEntity.name: How close to my trip can I cancel under CFAR?

acceptedAnswer.text: To use CFAR benefits, you must cancel your trip at least 48 hours before your scheduled departure. Cancellations made within 48 hours of departure are not eligible for CFAR reimbursement.

mainEntity.name: Is CFAR available on every Travel Guard plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: CFAR is available as an optional upgrade on eligible Travel Guard plans (typically the Deluxe and Preferred plans). Availability and terms vary by state of residence — confirm at quote time.
